usedFor: Ipregistrty looks up IP details, and “Parse a User-Agent” reads a browser string into its parts.

bestTemplate.name: “Parse a User-Agent” in Ipregistrty
bestTemplate.why: It tells you the browser and device behind a visit, from the string you pass in.

watchOut: “Parse a User-Agent” needs a string to read, so pass it from the event that carries one.
